requirement.statement: The system SHALL provide at least two immutable DomainContextBundle values through a production package that depends only on public contract/runtime roots, uses the live catalog/seed/bindings/probes API, stores semantic entries in catalog resources, exports no server or execution state, and models associations as explicit scalar-id entities until public relation compilation exists.

case.then: all definitions, bindings, probes, model sources, and complete presets are valid and frozen
business objects, association, lifecycle, constraint, process, capability, and raw resources are represented without private schema types

case.given: bundle production source and package metadata
case.when: the boundary guard and build run
case.then: only declared public roots are imported and capsule, private, generated, web-server, and test paths are rejected

requirement.statement: The it-asset-lifecycle bundle SHALL execute a BO query, CancelRepair BO Action, independent BO Mutation, association Mutation, lifecycle Transition, constraint Validate, business-process composed operation, and ScrapAndDispose extension Action; CancelRepair SHALL invoke its four registered children in order, root probes SHALL observe every affected entity, constraint violations SHALL be structured outcomes, and thrown business execution failures SHALL roll back and return diagnostics.

case.given: a repair case with returned loaner and damaged asset
case.then: four child refs are preserved, case and asset writes commit, and before/after/diff expose both changes

case.given: a repair case whose loaner is not returned
case.then: query and validation children remain visible, no write commits, and a stable execution diagnostic identifies failure

case.given: association, lifecycle, process, and disposal presets
case.then: real relational rows change with truthful mutation summaries and probes
both are successful structured outcomes whose valid field distinguishes business violation from execution failure

requirement.statement: The commerce-operations bundle SHALL execute a domain-context computed operation, filter/all/ids selection mutation as one single invocation, atomic and best-effort independent batch mutation with stable item keys, capability composition through registered children, raw graph/tree/table queries, and one atomic raw ingest whose payload batch does not change invocation mode.

case.given: filter, all, and ids ArchiveEligible presets
case.then: mode remains single; all performs an unfiltered public read; the handler deterministically resolves eligible rows; and shared-payload writes commit with truthful mutations and probes
keys and independent payload/status mapping are retained and partial commit is reported honestly

case.given: global summary, capability overview, and raw query presets
case.then: composite, graph, tree, and table outcomes contain seeded relational facts and composed child refs

case.given: one IngestBatch request containing multiple payload rows
case.then: invocation mode remains single, real rows are created, and a composite outcome plus mutation summaries reports them

requirement.statement: Every reference preset SHALL remain exact through catalog load and server exposure; sequential and concurrent executions SHALL start from deterministic seed; production server startup SHALL register both reference bundles while createApp without registrations SHALL remain empty; focused tests, package/root builds, import guards, and protected capsule manifests SHALL pass.

case.when: contract parsing, catalog matching, runtime load, and server catalog serialization run
case.then: the complete request remains semantically identical and directly executable
each response starts from equivalent seed and independent execution ids/state

case.given: default createApp and real import.meta.main startup composition
case.then: default remains empty and production startup exposes both bundle ids without importing server from the bundle package
